story.title: TGO – Tenant Onboarding Workflow and Lifecycle Refactor

requirements.text: Tenant onboarding uses workflow/tab navigation containing (1) Tenant Information and (2) Regions/Sites.
Save & Next functionality works correctly (persists current step and advances to the next step).
Tenant initially saves in Pending state and does not become Active immediately.
Tenant transitions to Active after onboarding completion.
Users can continue onboarding later (return to a Pending tenant and resume).
Existing Tenants remain unaffected / functional after deployment.
Region/Site management is accessible within the onboarding flow.
Tenant Information section contains Tenant Name, Tenant Description, Trilogy Go Domain, consistent with current onboarding fields.
Tenant becomes Active only after required onboarding steps are completed and Region/Site configuration requirements are satisfied; incomplete onboarding shall not activate the Tenant.
Users shall not bypass required onboarding steps.
Tenant onboarding progress shall persist between sessions.
Region management and Site management are consolidated under the Tenant onboarding experience instead of disconnected pages.
Onboarding visually guides the user through Tenant setup, Region setup and Site setup.
Existing Trilogy workflow/tab patterns are reused instead of new onboarding components.
Sites must always belong to a Region; orphan Sites shall not exist.
Duplicate Region names within the same Tenant shall not be allowed.
Region contains Region Name, Trilogy Base URL/domain, Region Description; empty state message and Add Region action are shown when no Regions exist; nested Region/Site grid with expand/collapse.
Existing Tenants/Sites migrate to the Region architecture: existing Site mappings, Trilogy Base URL relationships and active Tenants preserved; no orphan Sites.
Users with only View TGO Settings can view Tenant onboarding details and Region/Site hierarchy but cannot modify onboarding configuration, Regions or Sites.
An already existing Tenant cannot be created again.

requirements.source: Wiki (Tenants tab + icon) / sibling US 1411909 (/tgo routing)
requirements.text: Onboarding is launched from TGO (/tgo) > Tenants > + icon.
Tenants created in TGO are onboarded from the Trilogy platform (System > Tenant > Search by Trilogy Domain + Trilogy Go Domain > Onboard > Check Connectivity).

business_rules: BR1: A newly created tenant is Pending, never Active on creation (REQ-003).
BR2: Pending -> Active only when Tenant Information is complete AND Region/Site requirements are satisfied (REQ-004, REQ-009).
BR3: Required steps cannot be bypassed (REQ-010).
BR4: Onboarding progress persists between sessions and can be resumed (REQ-005, REQ-011).
BR5: Existing tenants keep functioning and are not moved back to Pending (REQ-006, REQ-018).
BR6: Sites always belong to a Region; Region names are unique per tenant (REQ-015, REQ-016).
BR7: A tenant that already exists cannot be created again (REQ-020).
functional_requirements: Region/Site management inside onboarding (REQ-007, REQ-012, REQ-015..REQ-017).
non_functional_requirements: Usability: guided step indicator, reuse of Trilogy tab patterns (REQ-013, REQ-014).
Reliability/Recovery: no duplicate or partial tenants on failure/double submit (REQ-002).
Security: no bypass through deep links or API; read-only permission enforcement (REQ-010, REQ-019).
Backward compatibility: migration of existing tenants (REQ-006, REQ-018).
No performance NFR stated (see Missing Requirements).
dependencies: Successor US 1411893 (Hierarchical Region and Site Management, Dev Review) - provides the nested Region/Site grid, Region/Site modals and validations used by the Regions/Sites step.
Sibling US 1411909 (Region Architecture, Backend and Migration, Closed) - lifecycle state storage, Region entity, migration of existing tenants, /tgo routing.
Sibling US 1411910 (Permissions and Access, Ready for Development) - View TGO Settings permission; REQ-019 cases are blocked until it is delivered.
Trilogy platform tenant onboarding (System > Tenant) consumes TGO tenants (wiki).
PR 185578 linked to the story (not reviewed - artifact link only).
constraints: Story is In Development; live UI exploration disabled - exact labels (tab names, button text, status labels, messages) must be confirmed against the build.
Task children 1471705, 1488339, 1488340, 1488342 skipped per policy; their titles indicate a Wizard mode for creation and a Non-Wizard mode for updating a tenant.
Full Region/Site CRUD, reassignment and deletion rules are owned by US 1411893 and only exercised here as far as onboarding needs.
assumptions: A1: Completing onboarding requires at least one Region with at least one Site (AC does not define the minimum).
A2: Regions/Sites step is not reachable for a brand-new tenant until Tenant Information is saved.
A3: Editing an existing tenant uses a non-wizard mode (free tab navigation) - from Task 1488342 title.
A4: Activation happens automatically on completion of the last required step (or via an explicit Complete/Finish action if present).
A5: Field limits/format rules for Tenant Name and Trilogy Go Domain are those of the current Add Tenant form.

test_conditions.text: Onboarding opens as an ordered tab/workflow with Tenant Information then Regions/Sites.
Save & Next saves the step data exactly once and advances; failures keep the user on the step with data retained.
First save of a new tenant creates it with status Pending (UI + persistence).
Pending -> Active only after all required steps and Region/Site requirements are complete.
A Pending tenant can be re-opened and resumed at the next incomplete step with saved data prefilled.
Pre-existing tenants keep Active status, sites, settings and connectivity after deployment and after edits.
Regions and Sites can be created/viewed from the Regions/Sites step of onboarding.
Tenant Information fields exist and validate consistently with the existing Add Tenant form.
Every incomplete combination of steps leaves the tenant Pending.
Later steps/activation cannot be reached through UI, deep link, or direct API before required steps are done.
Saved progress survives logout/login, browser change, refresh and session timeout.
Region/Site management is reached through the tenant, not via a disconnected page.
A visible progress indicator shows current/completed steps.
Workflow tabs look and behave like existing Trilogy tab patterns.
Site creation inside onboarding requires a Region.
Region name uniqueness is enforced per tenant during onboarding.
Regions/Sites step shows empty state, Region modal fields and nested grid.
Post-deployment data for existing tenants is intact and hierarchical.
Read-only users see onboarding read-only; writes are blocked in UI and API.
Duplicate tenant creation is rejected in the new workflow.
The Add Tenant entry point opens the new workflow.
Downstream Trilogy onboarding/connectivity works for new (completed) and existing tenants; Pending handling is defined.

traceability_matrix.requirement: Tenant onboarding uses workflow/tab navigation containing (1) Tenant Information and (2) Regions/Sites.
Save & Next functionality works correctly (persists current step and advances to the next step).
Tenant initially saves in Pending state and does not become Active immediately.
Tenant transitions to Active after onboarding completion.
Users can continue onboarding later (return to a Pending tenant and resume).
Existing Tenants remain unaffected / functional after deployment.
Region/Site management is accessible within the onboarding flow.
Tenant Information section contains Tenant Name, Tenant Description, Trilogy Go Domain, consistent with current onboarding fields.
Tenant becomes Active only after required onboarding steps are completed and Region/Site configuration requirements are satisfied; incomplete onboarding shall not activate the Tenant.
Users shall not bypass required onboarding steps.
Tenant onboarding progress shall persist between sessions.
Region management and Site management are consolidated under the Tenant onboarding experience instead of disconnected pages.
Onboarding visually guides the user through Tenant setup, Region setup and Site setup.
Existing Trilogy workflow/tab patterns are reused instead of new onboarding components.
Sites must always belong to a Region; orphan Sites shall not exist.
Duplicate Region names within the same Tenant shall not be allowed.
Region contains Region Name, Trilogy Base URL/domain, Region Description; empty state message and Add Region action are shown when no Regions exist; nested Region/Site grid with expand/collapse.
Existing Tenants/Sites migrate to the Region architecture: existing Site mappings, Trilogy Base URL relationships and active Tenants preserved; no orphan Sites.
Users with only View TGO Settings can view Tenant onboarding details and Region/Site hierarchy but cannot modify onboarding configuration, Regions or Sites.
An already existing Tenant cannot be created again.
